items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: When we didn't have Jimmy Rushing we had Witherspoon, Jimmy Witherspoon.

ctx.x: Yes that was a fairly well balanced trip.

Yes, that was a very good trip. And everybody, everything went okay. Then I went back again in '61 with almost the same guys except a different drummer. I had Oliver Jackson. When we didn't have Jimmy Rushing we had Witherspoon, Jimmy Witherspoon.
Did you take Sir Charles on that trip?

items.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996
items.q: Teddy had been there in China with Buck Clayton, Carlton Roberts and that bunch.

ctx.x: Had he been there for a while?
Yes he had. Teddy had been there in China with Buck Clayton, Carlton Roberts and that bunch.
That’s right, Buck Clayton was one of the first fellows to go over in that part of the world?
